description: This file defines the SavingsSchedularInterestPoster class responsible for posting interest to savings accounts, batch updating transactions and journal entries, handling interest posting logic, and interacting with the database.

classes.name: SavingsSchedularInterestPoster
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing scheduled interest posting, batch updates, and journal entry handling for savings accounts.

methods.name: postInterest
methods.description: Transactional method that posts interest for all savings accounts, handles errors, and performs batch updates.

methods.name: batchUpdateJournalEntries
methods.description: Performs batch insertion of journal entries related to savings transactions.

methods.name: batchQueryForJournalEntries
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string for inserting journal entries.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsFromIds
methods.description: Fetches transaction data from the database given a list of reference numbers.

methods.name: batchUpdate
methods.description: Performs batch updates of savings account summaries and transactions, and updates journal entries accordingly.

methods.name: batchQueryForTransactionInsertion
methods.description: Returns SQL string for batch inserting savings account transactions.

methods.name: batchQueryForSavingsSummaryUpdate
methods.description: Returns SQL string for updating savings account summaries.

methods.name: batchQueryForTransactionsUpdate
methods.description: Returns SQL string for updating savings account transactions.
